intro: Witch Doctor Uzer'i, after Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i, calls this a test of the ritual Uzer'i performed and of your own abilities. You are given a vessel that can shrink and capture a creature, and sent to the Hinterlands to take ten wildkin with it, then bring them back to Uzer'i in Feralas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. Take this vessel, friend. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it.

Travel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess Elune. The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, friend. Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to capture the wildkin?
If you succeed, we will be ready to shrink and capture the muisek of creatures of Feralas.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Upon a violent death, the muisek of a creature may escape and seek revenge. Shrinking the creatures, as you did, friend, prevents the muisek from escaping. Now we may use it as we please!
